page.title: Apps
page.subtitle: Add more to your store: turn each App on, set it up, or turn it off.
page.load_error: The Apps could not be loaded.
page.read_only: You can see this App but not change it.

descriptions.meta: Your Meta pixel on the storefront and your orders sent to Meta, to measure and steer your ads.
descriptions.dzverify: Customers confirm their phone with a WhatsApp code before they order.
descriptions.turnstile: Cloudflare's bot check on your order form, invisible to real customers.
descriptions.sendili: Your store's emails, such as team invites and password resets, sent from your own domain.
descriptions.whatsapp-button: A WhatsApp button on your storefront that opens a chat with you.
descriptions.telegram: Your own Telegram bot tells you and your team about new orders and deliveries, as they happen.
descriptions.reviews: Customers rate the products they received on your product pages, with photos or a voice note if you allow them.
descriptions.order-protection: Your own rules for incoming orders: send fake ones to Spam, flag doubtful ones and always accept good customers.

remove.title: Remove the App
remove.hint: Forgets its setup and every key it holds. To pause it and keep them, turn it off instead.
remove.confirm_body: Its setup and every key it holds are forgotten. You can set it up again later.
remove.failed: The App could not be removed. Please try again.
remove.partly: {name} was removed, but Telegram could not be told to stop sending the bot's messages to the store.

conversions.title: Conversions sent to Meta
conversions.subtitle: Your orders, sent to Meta's Conversions API as they happen, and how each delivery went.
conversions.none: Meta conversions start once the Meta App is set up.

meta.title: Pixel and conversions
meta.subtitle: Meta Pixel and Conversions API for ad attribution
meta.enabled_hint: When disabled, no Pixel or CAPI events will fire
meta.pixel_id_hint: Found in Meta Events Manager → Data Sources
meta.token_hint: Server-side token — never exposed to visitors. Leave empty to keep the stored token.
meta.ad_account_hint: Your own label for the Meta ad account — for reference only
meta.event_description: Choose which stage of your COD fulfillment funnel triggers the Meta Pixel & Conversions API event. This defines how Meta optimizes your ad spend.
meta.event_purchase_instant_label: Instant Purchase — at checkout (Recommended for Meta Ads)
meta.event_purchase_instant_hint: Fires Purchase immediately upon checkout with order total and deduplication ID. Essential for Facebook Ads real-time conversion optimization.
meta.event_purchase_confirmed_hint: Fires Purchase only when your call center confirms the order with the customer. Filters out 100% of fake leads while staying within Meta's 24h attribution window.
meta.event_purchase_delivered_hint: Optimizes toward delivered orders. For selected remote areas, the event may be sent when delivery begins to account for longer delivery transit times.
meta.event_lead_hint: Fires a Lead event immediately upon order placement. Select this if your Meta ad campaign optimizes for Leads instead of Purchases.
meta.test_mode_hint: Sends Conversions API events to Meta's test stream instead of production measurement
meta.test_mode_warning: Test mode is on — events are not counted for real measurement. Turn it off before going live.
meta.test_code_hint: From Events Manager → Test Events — required when test mode is on
meta.per_page_hint: Let an individual landing page report to its own pixel instead of this one. While this is off, every page uses the pixel above.
meta.per_page_next_step: Now open a landing page in the Studio and give it its own pixel. Pages you don't change keep using the store pixel.

dzverify.title: Phone check at checkout
dzverify.subtitle: A code on WhatsApp confirms each customer's phone before the order is placed.
dzverify.enabled_hint: Customers receive a code on WhatsApp before placing an order
dzverify.key_hint: Created at app.dzverify.com/api-keys — shown once at creation
dzverify.language_hint: The language the verification code is sent in
dzverify.check_no_credits: Balance exhausted — top up at app.dzverify.com.
dzverify.check_failed: Could not reach dzverify — try again

turnstile.title: Bot check at checkout
turnstile.subtitle: Bot protection for the checkout order form
turnstile.enabled_hint: Customers pass an invisible challenge before ordering (shows only when Cloudflare needs to verify)
turnstile.site_key_hint: Public key from your Turnstile widget (Cloudflare dashboard)
turnstile.secret_key_hint: Used to verify tokens server-side — never shown to customers, never sent to the browser
turnstile.hostname_hint: Your storefront domain must be added to the widget's allowed hostnames in the Cloudflare dashboard

sendili.title: Email sending
sendili.subtitle: Transactional emails via Sendili (team invites, password resets)
sendili.enabled_hint: When on, CodFlow sends transactional email (invites, password resets) through Sendili.
sendili.key_hint: Create an API key in your Sendili dashboard after verifying your sending domain.
sendili.from_hint: The sending address — its domain must be verified in your Sendili workspace.
sendili.domains_hint: Verified domains load automatically once a key is added — or use Test connection to refresh them.
sendili.check_no_credits: Out of credits — top up at sendili.com.

telegram.bot_subtitle: The bot that writes to you. You create it in Telegram, and it stays yours.
telegram.step_2: Choose its name, then a username ending in “bot”.
telegram.step_3: Copy the token BotFather gives you and paste it below.
telegram.token_hint: Kept on your store's server and never shown again. Telegram checks it before it is saved.
telegram.chat_subtitle: Where the bot sends your store's notifications.
telegram.not_connected: No chat is connected yet. Open Telegram from here and press Start: your chat connects at once.
telegram.waiting: Waiting for you to press Start in Telegram…
telegram.link_expires: The link works once and expires {when}.

test_failed.blocked: Telegram refused: the chat blocked the bot. Unblock it in Telegram, then try again.
test_failed.chat_not_found: Telegram cannot find the chat. Connect it again.
test_failed.unauthorized: Telegram no longer accepts the token. Save a new one from @BotFather.
test_failed.rate_limited: Telegram asked to slow down. Try again in a minute.
test_failed.unavailable: Telegram is having trouble. Try again later.
test_failed.unreachable: Telegram could not be reached. Try again later.

telegram.settings_subtitle: What the bot tells you, and in which language.
telegram.enabled_hint: Turned off, nothing is sent. Your bot and chat are kept.
telegram.language_hint: The language the bot writes in.
telegram.events_hint: New orders and how deliveries end are on by default.
telegram.deliveries_subtitle: Each notification and what Telegram answered.

attention.bot_blocked: The chat blocked the bot, so nothing is sent. Unblock the bot in Telegram: notifications start again by themselves.
attention.failing: Telegram is refusing the notifications. Look at what was sent below, then send a test message.

errors.load: The Telegram App could not be loaded.
errors.token_refused: Telegram does not accept this token. Copy it again from @BotFather.
errors.needs_public_url: Telegram can only reach your store over https. Set the server's public URL, then try again.
errors.refused: Telegram refused to send the bot's messages to your store. Try again in a moment.
errors.unreachable: Telegram could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
errors.failed: That did not work. Try again.

reviews.title: Review rules
reviews.subtitle: What customers can send, and what goes live without you checking it.
reviews.enabled_hint: Customers can review the products of a delivered order, and approved reviews show on your product pages. Turned off, reviews leave your storefront; none is deleted.
reviews.media_label: What shoppers can send with a review
reviews.media_photos_voice: Text, photos and a voice note
reviews.media_hint_text: Shoppers rate the product and write a few words.
reviews.media_hint_photos: Photos are resized and their location data removed. On the product page they show small until opened.
reviews.media_hint_voice: A voice note can replace the text, for shoppers who prefer to speak. It loads only when someone plays it.
reviews.media_hint_photos_voice: Photos show small until opened; a voice note loads only when played, so neither slows the product page.
reviews.publish_hint_off: Every review waits in Reviews until you approve it.
reviews.publish_hint_text_only: Text reviews go live at once; any with a photo or a voice note waits for you, since that is where a face or a phone number can appear.
reviews.publish_hint_all: Every review goes live at once, photos and voice notes included. You can still hide or delete any of them.
reviews.moderation_hint: Approve or reject reviews, and add the ones customers gave you by phone or in person.

order_protection.load_failed: This could not be loaded. Please try again.
order_protection.save_failed: This could not be saved. Please try again.
order_protection.switch_hint: When off, your rules are kept and every order goes through.

templates.title: Start with a template
templates.subtitle: Each template creates ordinary rules you can change at any time.
templates.recommended_hint: Acts only on what you block yourself. The other rules try themselves out and show what they would have caught.
templates.under_attack_hint: For a store receiving many fake orders right now. Doubtful orders go straight to Spam.
templates.empty_hint: No rules. You write your own.
templates.replace_body: The template takes the place of the rules you have now.

rules.delete_body: The rule is removed for good.
rules.unavailable: This rule can no longer be read, so it is skipped.
rules.would_catch_one: Would have caught {count} order in 7 days
rules.would_catch_other: Would have caught {count} orders in 7 days
rules.empty_hint: Add a rule or use a template.
